confidentUnsupported.evidence: First turn: 'the most likely cause is the automatic defrost system' was a mistaken guess for a static freezer, but it was hedged and later corrected.

rationale: The assistant opened with a wrong assumption (auto-defrost drain) for a static freezer, and even repeated 'most likely cause is a blocked defrost drain hole' after the customer raised the seal. It did reach the door seal once the customer found the split and flattened corner, and asked sensibly for the model number. At the end it only said no catalogue match was found and told the customer to go to the manufacturer or a parts supplier or an engineer. It never said to search for an Indesit IB55532W freezer door seal, never advised a full defrost before fitting, and never gave a clear DIY path, so the customer is only partly served.</br>
